verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a shared-inbox product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Missive. Adjacent items do not count: bring-your-own AI API keys, connecting custom MCP servers by URL, and connecting to IMAP servers with self-signed certificates. A community note says mail is fetched through Missive's servers, which points to a hosted-only service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
